name: Brother HL-L2400DW
model_check: Exact model HL-L2400DW (Europe/Israel/Asia-Pacific). Regional order codes HLL2400DWZU1 (UK), HLL2400DWRE1 (EU); HL-L2400DWE is the same printer sold with an EcoPro toner subscription. Same body as the HL-L2445DW but without the Ethernet port. Not the US HL-L2400D (no Wi-Fi).

closed.includes: Paper tray in, output support flap folded, back cover closed. Measured on the photos: the depth runs from the front panel to the small handle tab on the back cover; the flat back panel itself is about 0.9 cm in front of that tab. Cables are not included.

weight_kg.what: with toner and drum (6.0 kg without consumables)

connectivity.details: Hi-Speed USB 2.0 (USB-B), Wi-Fi 2.4 + 5 GHz (802.11a/b/g/n), Wi-Fi Direct. No Ethernet: Brother's user guide lists wired LAN only for the HL-L2445DW/2447DW/2460DN/2865DW, and the official HL-L2400DW back photo shows a blank plate where the 2445DW has its RJ45 jack. (Brother UK's spec table wrongly repeats 'Fast Ethernet' while its own summary says 'WiFi and USB'.)

paper.output_type: top tray, face down (plus 1 sheet face-up through the back cover)
paper.manual_feed: single-sheet slot behind a fold-down cover above the paper tray

toner.note: Codes for Europe and Israel. Australia/Asia use TN2530/TN2530XL and DR2530 with the same yields (Bug's HL-L2400DW page lists those Asian codes).

in_the_box.items: Printer with the starter toner (about 700 pages) already in the DR-2510 drum unit, AC power cord (C13 kettle-type, detachable), Quick Setup Guide, Product Safety Guide, warranty card. No USB cable.
in_the_box.region: Israel (Bug listing; matches Brother UK 'carton contents' and the Quick Setup Guide)
in_the_box.notes: Bug: printer, toner, drum ('מחסנית'), power cord, quick setup guide, warranty card; USB cable not included.

ils.where: zap.co.il (Rafaeli, lowest of the listed shops; Bug lists 669)

usd.note: Not a US model, so only importers list it in US$. Brother UK store: £133.42 incl. VAT on 2026-11-17.

power.type: C13 plug into a C14 inlet (mounted upright)
power.position: 1.6 cm from the left edge seen from behind (x = +16.2 cm in the model), 10.8 cm up; the inlet housing stands 0.5 cm proud of the flat back

data.type: USB-B (the RJ45 position above it is a blank plate)
data.position: 1.5 cm from the right edge seen from behind (x = -16.3 cm), 10.4 cm up, in a 1.1 cm deep corner niche

cable_space.why: The power inlet sits on the flat back strip, so the whole kettle plug and its strain relief stick out behind the printer; the USB port pocket is only about 1.1 cm deep, so the USB plug sticks out too (about 3.3 cm behind the body), but less than the power plug (6.5 cm, matches the 3D model).

notes: Same body as the HL-L2445DW without its Ethernet port; 30 instead of 32 pages/min and a smaller 700-page starter toner. Power plug: a straight-on kettle plug on a flat back, so plan about 6-7 cm behind the printer (the user's rule: flat back = 5-8 cm). The back cover folds down to become a 1-sheet face-up tray; it is only needed for thick paper.
